referents.why: Implied 'he' of the wayyiqtol 'he shut off the sea': the one who does the act is the LORD, speaker of the speech. Named in 38:1 and not repeated in this verse's candidate list.
'It came forth from the womb': the subject is the sea, the masculine singular candidate w4.
'It burst forth' in the infinitive: the sea, the masculine singular candidate w4.

links.why: The infinitive 'burst forth' sits inside the yiqtol 'when' clause, nested in its temporal role.
A clause cannot be then-linked to itself. 'Then' runs within a verse only, and cl0 has no within-verse predecessor: its waw continues the question series of 38:4-7.
The 'when' clause (infinitive inside the yiqtol) sets the time of the shutting, so it is nested in cl0's temporal role.

cant_tell.what: The waw of 38:8 cl0 and the question series of 38:4-7
cant_tell.why: A cross-verse relation. 'Then' is within-verse only (episode rung), so it is not recorded here.
